event_name: Will the FDV of OpenSea's token 1 week after launch be above Blur's FDV?

metadata.question: Will the FDV of OpenSea's token 1 week after launch be above Blur's FDV?
metadata.description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Fully Diluted Valuation of OpenSea's token 1 week after launch is above Blur's. Otherwise, the market will resolve to "No."

"1 week after launch" is defined as 12:00 PM ET, 7 days after it launches. For example, if the OpenSea token launches at 8 PM ET, March 15, then the FDV of OpenSea and Blur at 12:00 PM ET, March 22 will be used.

The resolution source for this market is CoinGecko, specifically the "Fully Diluted Valuation" metric. 1 week after OpenSea's token launch, OpenSea's FDV and Blur's FDV will be memorialized on the Polymarket market description here: https://polymarket.com/market/will-the-fdv-of-openseas-token-1-week-after-launch-be-above-blurs-fdv.

If OpenSea doesn't launch a token by December 31, 2023, 11:59:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

event_name: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after its February meeting?

metadata.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 25 bps after its February meeting?
metadata.description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal fund range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings. 

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for January 31 through February 1, 2023 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm. 

This market will resolve to “Yes” if following the Federal Reserve's January/February 2023 meeting the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is increased exactly 25 basis points over the level it was prior to the meeting. Otherwise, it will resolve to “No.” 

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm. 

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their January/February meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by February 8, 2023, 11:59:59 PM ET, this market will resolve 50-50.

metadata.description:

-----

If the number of tweets published by Elon Musk's verified Twitter account, @elonmusk, is 23,451 or greater on March 6, 2023, 12:00:00 PM ET, this market will resolve to "Yes". Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

This market will resolve according to the number of tweets found at 12:00:00 PM ET on March 6, 2023, and CANNOT resolve prior to that time (tweet numbers may decrease according to the source from deletes, etc.)

You can find Elon Musk's verified twitter account here: https://twitter.com/elonmusk. event_name: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 50 bps after its February meeting?

metadata.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 50 bps after its February meeting?
metadata.description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal fund range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings. 

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for January 31 through February 1, 2023 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm. 

This market will resolve to “Yes” if following the Federal Reserve's January/February 2023 meeting the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is increased exactly 50 basis points over the level it was prior to the meeting. Otherwise, it will resolve to “No.” 

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm. 

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their January/February meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by February 8, 2023, 11:59:59 PM ET, this market will resolve 50-50.

event_name: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 0 bps after its March meeting?

metadata.question: Will the Fed increase interest rates by 0 bps after its March meeting?
metadata.description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal fund range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for March 21-22, 2023 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if following the Federal Reserve's March 2023 meeting the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is exactly the same as the level it was prior to the meeting (namely it increased 0 bps). Otherwise, it will resolve to “No.”

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their March meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by April 30, 2023, 11:59:59 PM ET, this market will resolve 50-50.

event_name: Will more than 2.5 million people travel through a TSA checkpoint on any day by December 31?

metadata.question: Will more than 2.5 million people travel through a TSA checkpoint on any day by December 31?
metadata.description:
This is a market on whether more than 2.5 million people will travel through a TSA checkpoint on any single day between December 21, 2022 and December 31, 2022 (inclusive). 

The resolution source for this market will be the daily checkpoint throughput as measured by the US Transportation Security Administration (TSA), https://www.tsa.gov/coronavirus/passenger-throughput. Should this URL change or move locations a new URL on the tsa.gov domain will remain valid to resolve this market. 

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the TSA reports a daily checkpoint throughput of more than 2,500,000 for any day between December 21, 2022 and December 31, 2022 (inclusive). Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”. 

This market may not resolve to "No" until data for December 31, 2022 is available. 

This market will resolve as soon as throughput data becomes available for the date of December 31, 2022 or on any date before that if the target number is reached within the market timeframe. If the target number has not been reached and if data is not available for any of the days from December 21, 2022 to December 31, 2022, by January 7, 2023, the market will resolve to 50-50. Any revisions published to data for dates December 21, 2022 and onward prior to the release of data for December 31, 2022 will be considered.

event_name: Will Credit Suisse fail by March 31?

metadata.question: Will Credit Suisse fail by March 31?
metadata.description:
The market will resolve to "Yes" if Credit Suisse experiences any of the following between March 14 and March 31, 2023, 11:59:59 PM ET:

-Credit Suisse files for bankruptcy protection or is being declared insolvent by a court.
-Credit Suisse is closed or its operations are taken over by the Swiss government.
-Credit Suisse is acquired by, merged with, or its assets & liabilities are absorbed by another entity.
-The Swiss government intervenes to provide financial assistance, either in the form of equity or loans, to prevent the Credit Suisse's collapse.

Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

The primary resolution sources for this market will be announcements by Credit Suisse Group AG, the Swiss National Bank (SNB), and/or the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority (FINMA), however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

event_name: Will the Fed decrease interest rates by 25 bps after its March meeting?

metadata.question: Will the Fed decrease interest rates by 25 bps after its March meeting?
metadata.description:
The FED interest rates are defined in this market by the upper bound of the target federal funds range. The decisions on the target federal fund range are made by the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meetings.

The resolution source for this market is the FOMC’s statement after its meeting scheduled for March 21-22, 2023 according to the official calendar: https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if following the Federal Reserve's March 2023 meeting the upper bound of the target federal funds rate is decreased exactly 25 basis points under the level it was prior to the meeting. Otherwise, it will resolve to “No.”

The level and change of the target federal funds rate is also published at the official website of the Federal Reserve at https://www.federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/openmarket.htm.

This market may resolve as soon as the FOMC’s statement for their March meeting with relevant data is issued. If no statement is released by April 30, 2023, 11:59:59 PM ET, this market will resolve 50-50.

metadata.description:

If Trump ties for the greatest share of apportioned delegates, the popular vote will be used as a tiebreaker. If no 2024 Republican Iowa caucuses take place, this market will resolve to "No".

The resolution source for this market will be the first announcement of the results from the Iowa Republican party, however an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting may suffice.

This market will resolve to "Yes" if the Fully Diluted Valuation of Arbitrum's token is above $1,000,000,000 1 week after launch. Otherwise, the market will resolve to "No."

"1 week after launch" is defined as 12:00 PM ET, 7 calendar days after it launches. For example, if the token launches at 8 PM ET, March 16, then the FDV at 12:00 PM ET, March 23 will be used.

The resolution source for this market is CoinGecko, specifically the "Fully Diluted Valuation" metric. The FDV 1 week after launch will be memorialized on the Polymarket market description here: https://polymarket.com/market/will-the-fdv-of-arbitrums-token-be-above-1b-1-week-after-launch.

If Arbitrum doesn't launch a token by December 31, 2023, 11:59:59 PM ET, this market will resolve to 50-50.

event_name: Will more than 2.2 million people travel through a TSA checkpoint on any day by February 6?

metadata.question: Will more than 2.2 million people travel through a TSA checkpoint on any day by February 6?
metadata.description:
This is a market on whether more than 2.2 million people will travel through a TSA checkpoint on any single day between January 30, 2023 and February 6, 2023 (inclusive).

The resolution source for this market will be the daily checkpoint throughput as measured by the US Transportation Security Administration (TSA), https://www.tsa.gov/travel/passenger-volumes. Should this URL change or move locations a new URL on the tsa.gov domain will remain valid to resolve this market.

This market will resolve to “Yes” if the TSA reports a daily checkpoint throughput of more than 2,200,000 for any day between January 30, 2023 and February 6, 2023 (inclusive). Otherwise, this market will resolve to “No”.

This market may not resolve to "No" until data for February 6, 2023 is available.

This market will resolve as soon as throughput data becomes available for the date of February 6, 2023 or on any date before that if the target number is reached within the market timeframe. If the target number has not been reached and if data is not available for any of the days from January 30, 2023 to February 6, 2023 by February 13, 2023 the market will resolve to 50-50. Any revisions published to data for dates January 30, 2023 and onward prior to the release of data for February 6, 2023 will be considered.

metadata.question: 2022 Wimbledon Championships: Who will win Fritz vs. Nadal?
metadata.description:
The Wimbledon Championships, commonly known as 'The Championships' or simply 'Wimbledon', is the oldest tennis tournament in the world and is widely regarded as the most prestigious. It has been held at the All England Club in Wimbledon, London since 1877 and is played on outdoor grass courts. There have been retractable roofs over the two main courts since 2019. This is a market on who will advance after the Men’s Singles match between Taylor Fritz and Rafael Nadal, scheduled for July 6, 8:30 AM ET.

The market will resolve to “Fritz” if Taylor Fritz advances or to “Nadal” if Rafael Nadal advances. Please note that the market will resolve to whoever advances, even if the result is a "walkover".

If for any reason the person advancing is not declared by organizers by July 13, 11:59:59 PM ET, the market will resolve 50-50.
